description: E-REDES open data portal is an open data portal listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). The portal lists 70 datasets published by E-REDES (Portugal), covering the network operator's assets, capacity, demand, faults, forecasts and related reference data as tables, maps and time series with CSV, JSON and geographic exports. Coverage: Portugal. Each dataset page shows its fields, records, exports and API. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
